player_prompt.intro:
Ngeye Mwana nkenda {player_id}. Ngeye nkenda Mambu a Mbalula.
Ngeye na fwa kusolula mbalula kati ya {min_number} na {max_number} na mikolo {max_turns}.
Ngeye osinga solula, mambu ikutana ngeye na mawete oyo 'kuna juu' to 'kuna nsi'.
Ngeye singa pese mukumbi ngeye na njia yoyi. Mbalula oyo ikukatwa na mikwamba itazwa kama solula ngeye. Kwa mfano, [5].
Ngeye nkenda, mukumbi wa masolula ngeye ikukatwa na nsi. Sumba mawete yina kukwiza mambu liboso ngeye kukwiza mikolo.
Tika solula ngeye.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mbiso ya kutanga yina dosi. Mwanakiti {player_id} kaka sambwisa na 'mbalango ya kuzinga' '[number]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Muntu yina ke bulaka na {player_id} me zaba ntalu ya kele ve na ndonga.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Kobeta ezwami. Mbeti {player_id} akwisi zola ntumbo.

game_message.target_higher: Ntalu ya bantu yina bo vandaka kusosa kele mingi.
game_message.target_lower: Ntalu ya bantu yina bo vandaka kusosa kele fyoti.

outcome.win: Yo kele mbote, nge mezwa ntalu ya mefwana.
outcome.turn_limit: Mfuku wa ziku zinafikwa. Tanga: {guess}, Lelo: {target}
